library.description: Runtime-neutral storage contract: key-value store, codec, capability, context, key-domain and contract-level error types.

blocks.text: 运行时中立的存储契约。根入口只拥有类型、能力 token/定义、错误、枚举式常量和纯校验；执行、资源与作者快照由 `@migaia/storage-host/sdk` 拥有。基础包不依赖 host、浏览器存储或数据库客户端。

items: `@migaia/storage-contract`：存储/codec/context/query/transaction 类型、标准 token、定义身份和纯校验。
`@migaia/storage-contract/conformance`：由消费者现有 runner 执行的后端契约组；不内置 runner，也不依赖 host。
后端和 host 向内依赖本包。运行时作者 API 从下表入口导入；根入口不保留旧名称重导出或兼容别名。

rows: 键快照、有序键/组织编码、批次键 capture/projection
term、RDF 快照/编码、组织图映射
blob 输入快照、body reader 与 object 资源
createMigrationPlan、迁移执行与 envelope 恢复

blocks.text: 这些入口属于 `@migaia/storage-host`。`/sdk` 继续拥有既有有限后端接点；共享模板捕获仅是 SQL/SPARQL 的内部模块，不是公开子路径。使用步骤见 USEGUIDE 与 host 指南。

`IStorageBase` 是 backend、capabilities 和原资源清理接口；`IKeyValueStore` 加入文本操作；`IRecordStore` 加入 bytes、records、iteration 与 transaction。`ISyncKeyValueStore` 只描述真实同步文本通道。query、transaction、vector、RDF、blob、TTL、counter、durable feed 的接口和输入类型继续从本包导入。

rows: 检查当前完整 shape 与能力事实，不复制、不调用存储或清理方法
成功返回同一原对象；缺能力报 `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`
检查布尔事实与可选非负安全整数 `maxValueBytes`；不补写调用方字段
检查 typed-key 域或字符串域；分别沿 `INVALID_KEY` / `INVALID_ARGUMENT` 边界
校验字段，不分配快照、计时器或取消订阅
校验非空 name、text/binary/structured output 和可调用 encode/decode；不执行转换
校验规范 UUID 或 text/bytes/record/vector/RDF 锁域
复用向量 schema、有限分量及稠密 ID 规则，不复制输入
复用 RDF 词法与位置规则；完整 quad 必须有四个位置
复用锁目标及非负期限规则；TTL 不接纳 RDF 目标
只校验 blob 的 key/body/options 结构，不取得 reader
校验原 envelope 或同步回调形状，不执行迁移/事务

blocks.text: shape guard 面向普通受支持输入，不承诺拦截抛错 getter、Proxy、恶意 thenable 或属性读取次数。异步执行、native 错误归一及取消结果属于相应运行时拥有者。
`IStorageKey` 接纳有限数、字符串、有效 Date、ArrayBuffer，以及这些值构成的非空稠密嵌套数组。深度上限 32，节点上限 4096，每个二进制组件上限 1 MiB；循环、空数组、稀疏数组和普通对象不在键域内。纯 guard 不复制 Date、buffer 或数组。异步保留输入时使用 host 的键快照。
`IOperationContext.timeoutMs` 是非负安全整数，`pageSize` 是 1–4096 的整数；省略不插入缺省值。signal 使用结构化 `IAbortSignal`，已取消的有效信号仍可通过 shape 校验。同步写选项只接纳可选 `conflictPolicy`，不接纳非 undefined 的 signal/timeoutMs。
`IStorageCapabilities.batch` 声明完整 KV 批量写与计数前缀删除；省略表示不支持。共享 conformance 将未声明的 batch 组记为不适用。`secondaryIndexes`、`changeFeed` 的旧省略形状可通过 guard；需要独立规范化说明的 host 快照把这两项补 false。

`defineStorageCapability`、标准 `kv/records/sql/ttl/counter/vector/rdf/sparql/blob/durableChangeFeed` token 和 `implement` 留在本包。名称只作诊断；同名 token 不能互换。`readCapabilityTokenFacts` 与 `readStorageImplementation` 只读取原定义身份，不发布能力、不执行回调、不维护每 store 表。
publication、store has/use 和 transaction implementation lookup 统一由 host `/sdk` 拥有。调用方继续使用同一 token 和原 API 实例；支持合法 class 的方法 receiver。查询/事务/锁/iterator 的状态表也只在 host 中存在。

`StorageContractError` 保持 `source: 'storage.contract'`、公开 code、原 `cause`、原 stack 与扩展 details。未改名或新增错误码。`INVALID_ARGUMENT` 表示输入结构问题，`INVALID_KEY` 表示 typed-key 域问题，`UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY` 表示缺少已请求能力；执行拥有者继续使用本包既有生命周期、并发、查询和迁移码。
错误实例保留既有冻结行为，cause 对象不会随之冻结。归档迁移的进度错误通过既有 `onArchiveRunError` 通道报告，不修改已冻结错误实例。codec 不承诺冻结或复制：纯 `assertCodec` 只校验；host `snapshotCodec` 校验后返回同一实例，使 `#private` 方法保持 receiver。
普通 store/options/query 与输入快照不作为冻结协议。需要跨排队、native await 或公开返回值边界隔离可变 Date、bytes、数组、RDF term 时，由相应 host 作者入口说明并执行必要复制。公开锁诊断的键必须与仍活动的原 lease 分离。
存储 codec 使用的 `@migaia/serialize` 格式编码器现按对象自身的属性枚举顺序输出字段，不再按字段名排序。相同字段和值、不同插入顺序的对象，编码字节可能不同；解码后的字段和值不变。依赖旧排序字节的快照、签名输入或缓存键应按新顺序重新生成，不能把旧字节顺序当作存储契约。

递归 `Map`、`Set` 值改用 `@migaia/serialize/codecs/collections-json` 的 `defineCollectionsJsonCodec`，再从 `@migaia/storage-host/sdk` 使用 `fromValueCodec` 适配。普通 JSON codec 不隐式开启集合编码；新写入格式的旧消费者需同步迁移。格式细节见 serialize 指南。
先区分纯校验与执行拥有者。类型、token、定义和错误从 `@migaia/storage-contract` 导入；需要保存可变输入、运行查询或管理资源时，使用 README 的 host 入口表。

blocks.code:
import { assertStorageKey, type IStorageKey } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const input: unknown = ['orders', new Date(0)]
assertStorageKey(input, 'memory')
const key: IStorageKey = input
console.log((key as [string, Date])[1].getTime()) // 0

blocks.text: 纯校验不打开 store，也不复制键。需要在异步写入前保留键时，由 host 原作者入口复制可变组件：

blocks.code:
import { snapshotStorageKey } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'

const input = ['orders', new Date(0)] as const
const saved = snapshotStorageKey(input, 'memory') as [string, Date]
input[1].setTime(1000)
console.log(saved[1].getTime()) // 0

blocks.text: 没有跨异步或公开所有权边界的同步校验直接使用原输入，不建立第二份快照。

blocks.code:
import { assertOperationContext, assertSyncWriteOptions } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

assertOperationContext({ timeoutMs: 0, pageSize: 100 })
assertSyncWriteOptions({ conflictPolicy: 'replace' })

blocks.text: 这两个函数不运行取消、计时或写入。非法字段沿现有 `INVALID_ARGUMENT` 边界；省略字段不插入后端默认值。signal 是原 live signal，已取消的有效信号也符合 shape。

blocks.code:
import { snapshotOperationContext } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'

const controller = new AbortController()
const options = { signal: controller.signal, timeoutMs: 10 }
const captured = snapshotOperationContext(options)!
options.timeoutMs = 20
controller.abort()
console.log(captured.timeoutMs, captured.signal === controller.signal) // 10 true
console.log(captured.signal?.aborted) // true

blocks.text: 快照用于后续实际 await，不冻结，不保证再次 snapshot 返回相同对象，也不承诺属性读取次数。后端已捕获的上下文应复用，不重复复制。

sections.id: 识别能力而不取得资源
sections.heading: 识别能力而不取得资源

blocks.code:
import { isStorageCapabilities, type IStorageCapabilities } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const facts: IStorageCapabilities = {
  syncRead: false,
  binary: false,
  records: false,
  transactions: false,
  iteration: false,
  secondaryIndexes: false,
  changeFeed: false,
  maxValueBytes: undefined,
  opaqueEntries: false
}
console.log(isStorageCapabilities(facts)) // true

blocks.text: `batch` 省略表示不提供完整批量写；共享 conformance 的该组记为不适用。shape guard 不创建规范化副本。需要在宿主异步准入期间保存事实时，从 `/sdk` 使用 `snapshotStorageCapabilities`。
这一步没有发布 store。发布和 has/use 在 host `/sdk`；定义 token 的名字不能替代原对象身份。完整资源和清理示例见 host 指南。

`assertCodec(codec)` 只检查普通对象或合法 class 的公开结构。`snapshotCodec` 已归 host `/sdk`，现在校验后借用同一对象；它不复制 `{name, output, encode, decode}`，因此 `#private` 方法不会丢失 receiver。调用使用 `codec.encode(value)` / `codec.decode(raw)`。格式转换适配仍使用同入口的 `fromValueCodec`。
既有错误实例仍冻结，cause 与 stack 保留。归档迁移通过原 `onArchiveRunError` 报告进度，不向错误实例添加状态。

从 `@migaia/storage-contract/conformance` 导入 `runConformance`，提供消费者原有的 describe/it/expect（以及可选 skip）、fresh fixture、真实 token 清单和能力事实。每组执行原公开操作并清理该 fixture；不安装第二个 runner，不据后端名字推断未声明能力。完整参数类型是同入口的 `IConformanceHarness` 与 `IConformanceSubject`。

Runtime-neutral storage contracts. The root owns types, capability tokens/definitions, errors, enum-like constants and pure validators. Execution, resources and authoring snapshots belong to `@migaia/storage-host/sdk`. This module does not depend on host, browser storage or database clients.

items: `@migaia/storage-contract`: storage, codec, context, query and transaction types; standard tokens; definition identity; pure validation.
`@migaia/storage-contract/conformance`: backend contract groups run by the consumer's existing runner. It supplies no runner and imports no host runtime.
Host and backends depend inward on this module. Runtime authoring APIs use the entries below; the root retains no old runtime re-export or compatibility alias.

rows: Publication, original store has/use, transaction implementation lookup
Record/vector/RDF queries, condition compilation and snapshots
Policies, lock factories, the concurrency loop and lock snapshots
Transaction owner, builder, execution and iterator derivation
Key copies, ordered/organization encoding and batch capture/projection
Store admission and capability descriptor snapshots
Fragments, native tags and terminal binding
Term factories, snapshots, encoding and organization graphs
Vector input snapshots and recommendation synthesis
Input snapshots, upload readers and object resources
Value-codec adapter and original codec admission
Migration plans, execution and envelope recovery

blocks.text: All these entries belong to `@migaia/storage-host`. `/sdk` retains its finite backend ports. Shared template capture remains a private SQL/SPARQL module. See the usage guide and host guide.

`IStorageBase` describes backend, capabilities and the original cleanup surface. `IKeyValueStore` adds text operations; `IRecordStore` adds bytes, records, iteration and transactions. `ISyncKeyValueStore` describes a real synchronous text channel. Query, transaction, vector, RDF, blob, TTL, counter and durable-feed types remain here.

rows: Check complete supported shapes and capability facts without copying or invoking native methods
Return the same original object; missing capability reports `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`
Checks boolean facts and optional nonnegative safe-integer `maxValueBytes`; never fills caller fields
Validate typed or string keys; retain `INVALID_KEY` / `INVALID_ARGUMENT` respectively
Validate fields without a snapshot, timer or abort subscription
Checks nonempty name, text/binary/structured output and callable encode/decode; performs no conversion
Validate canonical UUIDs and text/bytes/record/vector/RDF lock domains
Reuse schema, finite-component and dense-ID rules without input copies
Reuse lexical and positional rules; complete quads require all four positions
Reuse target and nonnegative-duration rules; RDF is not a TTL target
Validate keys, bodies and option shapes without acquiring a reader
Validate the original envelope or callback without executing migration or transaction work

blocks.text: Guards accept ordinary supported inputs. They promise no hostile getter, Proxy or thenable interception and no property-read count. Runtime owners retain native failure normalization, cancellation and actual operation outcomes.

`IStorageKey` accepts finite numbers, strings, valid Dates, ArrayBuffers and nonempty dense nested arrays of those values. Limits are depth 32, 4096 visited nodes and 1 MiB per binary component. Cycles, sparse/empty arrays and ordinary objects are invalid. Pure validation does not copy key data; use host key snapshots when asynchronous work retains mutable input.

`IOperationContext.timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer and `pageSize` is an integer from 1 through 4096. Omission supplies no default. A structurally valid already-aborted `IAbortSignal` is accepted. Sync write options allow optional `conflictPolicy`, without non-undefined signal/timeoutMs.

`IStorageCapabilities.batch` declares complete KV batch writes and counted prefix deletion. Omission means unsupported, and shared conformance marks that group not applicable. Legacy omissions of secondaryIndexes/changeFeed pass pure shape admission; host descriptor snapshots normalize those two flags to false.

Custom and standard capability tokens plus `implement` stay here. Names are diagnostics; same-name tokens are not interchangeable. `readCapabilityTokenFacts` and `readStorageImplementation` inspect canonical definition identity without publication, callback execution or per-store state.

Host `/sdk` owns publication, store has/use and transaction implementation lookup. It uses the same token and original API identity, including legitimate class receivers. Query, transaction, lock and iterator runtime state belongs only to host.

`StorageContractError` retains source `storage.contract`, its public code, original cause and stack, and extension details. No code was added or renamed. `INVALID_ARGUMENT` denotes argument shape, `INVALID_KEY` denotes the typed-key domain, and `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY` denotes missing requested behavior. Runtime owners reuse the existing lifecycle, query, concurrency and migration codes.

Error instances retain their existing frozen behavior; cause objects are not frozen with them. Archive migration reports progress failures through the existing `onArchiveRunError` hook rather than modifying the frozen error. Codec admission does not clone or freeze: pure `assertCodec` validates, while host `snapshotCodec` returns the same admitted instance so class-private methods keep their receiver.

Ordinary store, option, query and snapshot records are not a freezing protocol. Host authors retain copies only where queued/native awaits or a public ownership boundary exposes mutable Date, bytes, array or RDF data. Public lock diagnostics detach keys from a still-active native lease.

The `@migaia/serialize` format encoders used by storage codecs now emit fields in the object's own property enumeration order instead of sorting field names. Objects with equal fields and values but different insertion orders can produce different bytes. Decoded fields and values are unchanged. Regenerate snapshots, signature inputs or cache keys that depend on the former sorted bytes.

For recursive `Map` and `Set` values, select `defineCollectionsJsonCodec` from `@migaia/serialize/codecs/collections-json` and adapt it with `fromValueCodec` from `@migaia/storage-host/sdk`. Plain JSON does not enable collection encoding implicitly. Older consumers must migrate together before reading the new format. See the serialize guide.
Import types, tokens, definitions, errors and pure validators from `storage.contract`. Input retention, query execution and resources use the host entry table.

blocks.code:
import { assertStorageKey, type IStorageKey } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const input: unknown = ['orders', new Date(0)]
assertStorageKey(input, 'memory')
const key: IStorageKey = input
console.log((key as [string, Date])[1].getTime()) // 0

blocks.text: Validation opens no store and copies no key. When asynchronous writes retain caller data, the original host authoring helper detaches mutable components:

blocks.code:
import { snapshotStorageKey } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'

const input = ['orders', new Date(0)] as const
const saved = snapshotStorageKey(input, 'memory') as [string, Date]
input[1].setTime(1000)
console.log(saved[1].getTime()) // 0

blocks.text: Synchronous validation with no asynchronous or public ownership boundary borrows the original input.

blocks.code:
import { assertOperationContext, assertSyncWriteOptions } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

assertOperationContext({ timeoutMs: 0, pageSize: 100 })
assertSyncWriteOptions({ conflictPolicy: 'replace' })

blocks.text: These functions execute no cancellation, timers or writes. Invalid fields retain `INVALID_ARGUMENT`; omission supplies no backend default. Structurally valid aborted signals remain valid inputs.

blocks.code:
import { snapshotOperationContext } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'

const controller = new AbortController()
const options = { signal: controller.signal, timeoutMs: 10 }
const captured = snapshotOperationContext(options)!
options.timeoutMs = 20
controller.abort()
console.log(captured.timeoutMs, captured.signal === controller.signal) // 10 true
console.log(captured.signal?.aborted) // true

blocks.text: Snapshots support later real awaits. They are not frozen, do not promise repeated-call identity, and specify no accessor read count. Reuse a context already captured by its backend owner.

sections.heading: Inspect capabilities without acquiring a resource

blocks.code:
import { isStorageCapabilities, type IStorageCapabilities } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const facts: IStorageCapabilities = {
  syncRead: false,
  binary: false,
  records: false,
  transactions: false,
  iteration: false,
  secondaryIndexes: false,
  changeFeed: false,
  maxValueBytes: undefined,
  opaqueEntries: false
}
console.log(isStorageCapabilities(facts)) // true

blocks.text: Omitted `batch` means no complete batch-write support; shared conformance marks that group not applicable. Pure shape guards do not normalize copies. Host `/sdk` supplies `snapshotStorageCapabilities` when deferred admission must retain those facts.
This creates no published store. Host `/sdk` owns publication and has/use. A token's name never substitutes for the original identity. Resource and cleanup examples remain in the host guide.

`assertCodec(codec)` checks the public shape of an ordinary object or legitimate class. Host `/sdk` owns `snapshotCodec`: it validates and borrows the same original instance. It does not copy `{name, output, encode, decode}`, so methods using `#private` state retain their receiver. Invoke `codec.encode(value)` and `codec.decode(raw)` directly. `fromValueCodec` remains the format adapter on that same entry.
Existing error instances remain frozen; original cause and stack survive. Archive migration reports progress through its existing `onArchiveRunError` hook rather than adding state to errors.

Import `runConformance` from `@migaia/storage-contract/conformance`. Supply the consumer's existing describe/it/expect and optional skip, fresh fixtures, actual token list and capability facts. Groups execute public operations and clean each fixture. They install no extra runner and infer no unlisted capability from a backend name. The entry exports the exact `IConformanceHarness` and `IConformanceSubject` types.

symbols.signature: export declare function runConformance<TStore extends IStorageStore<never>>(harness: IConformanceHarness, subject: IConformanceSubject<TStore>): void;
symbols.purpose: Register all declared standard-token and Boolean behavior groups without acquiring a runner, host or driver dependency. Every case validates the complete manifest and finally disposes its original fixture; primary and cleanup failures remain reachable. Invalid-input assertions observe both synchronous native throws and Promise rejection without changing the required original semantic code.
symbols.core:
harness: Original describe/it/expect registration and matchers. Notification waiting uses only this runner’s case timeout.
subject: Name, independent create factory, complete authentic capability list and full features snapshot, plus optional prepareSecondaryIndexes(originalStore, originalHandle) calling only the native backfill owner. It may return the original record-key projection for fixture ids; complete readiness remains required. KV is selected by kv token; pure vector/SQL subjects need none.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Register all declared standard-token and Boolean behavior groups without acquiring a runner, host or driver dependency. Every case validates the complete manifest and finally disposes its original fixture; primary and cleanup failures remain reachable. Invalid-input assertions observe both synchronous native throws and Promise rejection without changing the required original semantic code.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import runConformance from @migaia/storage-contract/conformance, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use runConformance when its function contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when runConformance does not match the required inputs or return contract.
